mapper.sql: SELECT r.id AS token_id, r.user_id, r.token_hash, r.expires_at, r.revoked_at, r.replaced_by_token_id, r.version AS token_version, r.created_at AS token_created_at, u.username, u.password_hash, u.display_name, u.status AS user_status, u.last_login_at, u.version AS user_version, u.created_at AS user_created_at, u.updated_at AS user_updated_at, t.id AS tenant_id, t.name AS tenant_name, t.status AS tenant_status, t.created_at AS tenant_created_at, t.updated_at AS tenant_updated_at FROM iam_refresh_tokens r JOIN iam_users u ON u.id = r.user_id JOIN tenants t ON t.id = u.tenant_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_refresh_tokens (id, user_id, token_hash, expires_at, revoked_at, replaced_by_token_id, version, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{user.id}, #{tokenHash}, #{expiresAt}, #{revokedAt}, #{replacedByToken.id}, #{version}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.revoked_at IS NULL ORDER BY r.created_at, r.id
mapper.update: UPDATE iam_refresh_tokens SET revoked_at = #{revokedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND revoked_at IS NULL
